title: Claude adds 29 marketing skills #claude #marketingskills #marketingai
description:
Claude now supports plug-in marketing skills that can generate structured outputs for content strategy, copywriting, campaign planning, and other core marketing functions. A newly shared library includes 29 ready-to-use skill files that can be added directly inside Claude’s Skills settings.

The workflow is simple: download a raw skill file from the library, upload it in Claude under Capabilities, and start a new chat with a task-specific prompt. Claude then applies the selected skill automatically and returns a more organized, role-specific framework.

The broader shift is toward modular AI workflows, where specialized prompt layers turn a general model into a practical tool for business execution. For marketers, founders, and small teams, that means faster strategy development, lower execution overhead, and access to agency-style outputs without building complex systems from scratch.
